text: An intriguing potential strategy for enhancing hypertrophic gains is to integrate loaded stretch into the interset rest periods. In support of this approach, Silva and colleagues (80) randomized 24 resistance-trained men to perform 4 sets of plantar flexion on a leg press machine at a load corresponding to 8RM to 12RM either with or without interset stretching. The stretch training protocol required participants to maintain the load of the machine for 30 seconds in dorsiflexion after completion of each set, whereas the non-stretched group rested passively throughout the rest period. Training was carried out twice per week for 5 weeks.
